projects.title: Brava : Corporate Company Profile
projects.summary: Official corporate company profile website for Brava, built with Next.js 16 App Router as a headless consumer.
projects.description: A high-performance corporate company profile website for Brava engineered with Next.js 16 and React 19. Designed as a headless consumer, it fetches live content, services, portfolio items, and SEO metadata from the Brava CMS REST API, complemented by smooth GSAP entrance animations.
highlights: Headless consumer architecture powered by Next.js 16 App Router (RSC)
Interactive scroll and entrance micro-interactions built with GSAP 3
Tailwind CSS v4 styling with responsive mobile-to-desktop design tokens
Dynamic services, blog articles, and portfolio gallery showcase
Automated SEO suite: OpenGraph, JSON-LD structured data, dynamic sitemap.xml & robots.txt
Live production deployment on https://brava.id
projects.problem: Brava required an authoritative, modern, and blazingly fast corporate web presence to showcase services, client deliverables, and company credentials without sacrificing SEO or performance.
projects.solution: Developed a headless Next.js 16 frontend that consumes structured content from the backend REST API, utilizing React Server Components for instantaneous initial page loads and GSAP for premium brand animations.
projects.contribution: Architected the frontend application, designed responsive UI sections, integrated REST API query clients, optimized Core Web Vitals, and configured production deployment to brava.id.

visual.alt: Brava corporate company profile website homepage interface

projects.title: Brava CMS : Headless Content Platform
projects.summary: A modular, high-performance headless CMS and REST API built with Laravel 13 to manage digital content, media, and SEO.
projects.description: A standalone, modular headless Content Management System engineered with Laravel 13 and Tailwind CSS v4. Features automated cache invalidation, media library compression, GA4 analytics integration, and granular REST API endpoints for decoupled frontends.
highlights: Headless REST API with flexible caching and automated cache invalidation (ClearsApiCache)
Centralized media library with automated image resizing and compression (Intervention/Image)
Automated SEO meta generator with absolute URLs and dynamic sitemap endpoint
Google Analytics 4 (GA4) dashboard reporting with smart stale-while-revalidate caching
Modular content management: Portfolio, Blog, Testimonials, Services, and System Settings
Rigorous automated test coverage powered by Pest PHP
projects.problem: Content editors needed an intuitive, centralized management portal to update marketing content, media galleries, and SEO metadata without touching codebase or redeploying the frontend.
projects.solution: Engineered a headless Laravel CMS with automated API cache clearing on updates, strict form validation, media pipelines, and a structured REST API contract.
projects.contribution: Designed database schemas, developed REST API endpoints, implemented automatic cache purging traits, and built administrative management interfaces.
architecture: REST API Layer with Auto Cache Invalidation

visual.alt: Brava CMS headless content management system administrative interface

projects.title: SM Sport Center : Court Reservation & Payment
projects.summary: A responsive online court reservation platform for Futsal and Badminton featuring continuous slot validation and automated Midtrans Snap payment integration.
projects.description: A comprehensive sports court booking platform built with Laravel 13, Blade, and Tailwind CSS. Enables players to discover venues, inspect live schedules, and secure reservations with continuous time-slot validation. Integrated with Midtrans Snap for automated payments (QRIS, VA, E-Wallet) and secure SHA-512 webhook synchronization.
highlights: Public court catalog with multi-sport filtering (Futsal and Badminton) and time-of-day slots
Real-time booking engine with concurrency protection to prevent double-booking
Continuous slot validation enforcing uninterrupted booking hours
End-to-end Midtrans Snap checkout supporting QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and E-Wallets
Secure automated webhook handler with SHA-512 cryptographic signature verification
Dynamic facility photo gallery and complete administrative management dashboard
projects.problem: Manual court booking through messaging apps led to frequent scheduling conflicts, unverified payment slips, double-booked hours, and tedious manual bookkeeping for venue operators.
projects.solution: Architected a centralized booking portal with atomic transaction locks to eliminate double-booking, enforced continuous time-slot selection rules, and integrated Midtrans Snap for automated payment settlement and instant confirmation.
projects.contribution: Designed relational database schemas, built booking state machines with overlap validation, integrated Midtrans Snap API and SHA-512 webhook listener, and developed the responsive Tailwind CSS user interface.

visual.alt: SM Sport Center online court booking and payment interface

projects.title: Point of Sale : Retail & ERP Management
projects.summary: An enterprise Point of Sale platform built with Laravel 13, Inertia.js React, and TypeScript featuring granular RBAC, real-time analytics, and automated reporting.
projects.description: A modern, full-stack Point of Sale (POS) and retail management application powered by Laravel 13, Inertia.js, React 19, and Tailwind CSS. Built with a granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) architecture using Spatie Permission, real-time revenue analytics charts via Recharts, automated financial reporting with Excel export, and integrated multi-channel checkout.
highlights: Granular dynamic Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with permission groups and policy enforcement
High-speed POS cashier terminal with real-time checkout dialog and receipt generation
Interactive business analytics dashboard with flexible temporal granularity (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
Real-time inventory catalog, stock level alerts, and multi-parameter product filtering
Automated financial and sales transaction reporting with spreadsheet (Excel) export
End-to-end type safety across the Inertia.js stack powered by TypeScript and Wayfinder
projects.problem: Retail merchants and multi-branch businesses struggle with rigid POS systems that lack granular access control, leading to unauthorized staff overrides, cumbersome inventory tracking, and delayed sales reporting.
projects.solution: Engineered a decoupled, full-stack POS platform combining Laravel 13 with Inertia.js React. Implemented granular permission matrices, an intuitive reactive checkout interface, and instant analytical dashboards for real-time operational oversight.
projects.contribution: Architected the full-stack system from database schemas to reactive frontend components, implemented the Spatie RBAC authorization layer with custom frontend permission hooks, developed the analytics query pipeline, and styled the UI using Tailwind CSS and Radix UI primitives.

visual.alt: Point of Sale retail management platform dashboard interface

projects.title: DoneLock : Personal Productivity Journal
projects.summary: A brutalist mobile productivity journaling application built with Flutter and Firebase featuring annual contribution heatmaps and habit reflection.
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile productivity journaling application engineered with Flutter and Dart, backed by Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore. Built with an opinionated brutalist aesthetic, DoneLock replaces complex to-do lists with daily reflection journaling, visual 7x52 GitHub-style contribution heatmaps, monthly calendar views, and scheduled local notifications to build long-term consistency.
highlights: Daily reflection journaling with productive toggle, mood tracking, and reflective notes
7x52 annual contribution heatmap visualizing productivity momentum throughout the year
Interactive monthly calendar view with date-based status highlighting
Cloud Firestore real-time synchronization with offline persistence support
Timezone-aware scheduled local push notifications for daily habit reinforcement
Google Sign-In and secure Firebase Authentication integration
projects.problem: Traditional productivity tools like complex kanban boards and nested task managers overwhelm users with cognitive friction, focusing on busywork rather than meaningful self-reflection and habit consistency.
projects.solution: Designed a brutalist, distraction-free journaling experience centered on one core question: 'Was today productive?'. Combined with GitHub-style visual heatmaps and calendar trends to celebrate consistency over complexity.
projects.contribution: Architected the mobile application end-to-end, designed the brutalist UI system in Flutter, implemented Riverpod reactive state management, integrated Firebase Auth and Firestore with offline caching, and configured background local notifications.
architecture: Flutter Reactive UI & Brutalist Design System
Cloud Firestore Data Models & Offline Cache

visual.alt: DoneLock personal productivity journaling mobile app interface
